question: At equal Budget24 authoritative bytes, can direct slab-level terminal sensitivity reduce terminal KL relative to the existing local selector, and does the ranking make budgets below 24 more viable?

model.representation_boundary: The deployed KDA-hybrid GGUF and the natural sidecars have different source quantization identities. All-192 natural sidecar slabs are therefore the representation-matched routed teacher for this selector experiment; KL to the deployed native routed layer is a model-mismatch diagnostic, not selector damage.

protocol.teacher_definition: all 192 natural sidecar records at layer 92, with the exact frozen KDA-hybrid trajectory and suffix
protocol.baseline_definition: existing calibrated local residual selector at Budget24
protocol.atomic_intervention: drop one selected slab with equal-byte local replacement, or force one omitted slab with equal-byte eviction
protocol.integrity: All 192 independent-screen directories contain SHA256SUMS and passed sha256sum -c on 2026-08-31. Exact trajectory/state output hashes closed in every intervention.

rank_correlation.population: 168 slabs omitted by the local Budget24 selector
rank_correlation.interpretation: The local score is only weakly related to terminal value on this discovery point.

byte_accounting_boundary.curve_bytes: authoritative payload bytes for the single isolated layer's terminal provider call

interpretation.phase_a: GO: at exactly equal Budget24 bytes, the direct terminal ranking halved isolated-layer terminal KL relative to the local selector. Budgets 8, 12, and 16 also improved materially and the measured terminal-ranked curve was monotonic.
falsified: Local residual rank is a sufficient proxy for slab terminal value on this point.
Budget24 must remain the minimum registered representation for scientific testing.
More locally ranked slabs necessarily improve terminal KL; local Budget32 was worse than local Budget24.
not_established: Cross-prompt, cross-layer, or model-wide selector generalization.
Official-template output quality, tool-call recovery, decode throughput, or full-model bytes per token.
A cheap predictor of terminal slab utility; this ranking used measured interventions on the discovery point.
interpretation.next_gate: Validate prediction/ranking on held-out high-, medium-, and low-sensitivity layers and prompts before further coordinate descent or runtime implementation.
